criteria.requirement: Add ConfigObj.validated_reload(validator) using the actual original filename/options/configspec and the accepted fixed validation report. Build an independent candidate from disk, force missing-file failure without creating a file, revalidate actual types/defaults, return valid=false without touching the old tree on validation errors and propagate IO/parse/callback exceptions. Only successful validation replaces all values and metadata, retaining the caller root identity and reconnecting parent/main/depth plus cached interpolation engines. Keep original options and ordinary reload behavior; never cache implicit validator state.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
